title: Sustainable Agriculture
definition: Agricultural practices that meet current societal food and fiber needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs, by integrating environmental health, economic profitability, and social equity.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper 3 (Agriculture, Food Security, Environment, Land Degradation) and Prelims (schemes, practices like ZBNF/Natural Farming, missions, and bodies like NMSA).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sustainable Agriculture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Indian Agriculture and Cropping Patterns
Green Revolution impacts and environmental externalities
